Subject: Discovery recap & next steps - Zephyr Data

Hi Jake / Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really enjoyed learning more about Zephyr Data's pipeline enrichment use case and how you’re prioritizing faster entity resolution for downstream analytics. Quick recap and suggested next steps below.

Recap
- Current stack: in-house ETL feeding Snowflake + several downstream BI dashboards.
- Pain: entity matching errors cause manual funnels; engineering spends ~2 FTEs reconciling weekly mismatches.
- Goal: reduce manual reconciliation by 70% and cut latency on enrichment from minutes to seconds for near-real-time dashboards.
- Constraints: data residency for EU customers (future scope), 3rd-party connectors needed for legacy CRM.

What Redwood can help with (high level)
- Low-latency inference for enrichment at scale (continuous batching + KV cache).
- Dedicated deployment option for isolated datasets and audit logs.
- Model tuning for entity matching and reranking; embeddings for semantic joins.

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive w/ your infra lead (30-45m) to review data flow and integration points — available next week Tue/Wed 10-12 PT.
2) Pilot plan: 4-week pilot scoped to a single pipeline with success metrics (reconciliation rate, p50 latency).
3) Procurement intro: share indicative pricing and contract cadence once pilot is scoped.

Attachments: redwood-product-sheet.pdf (product brief)
Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/pilot-playbook (pilot outline)

If either Tue/Wed works for a quick tech call, I’ll send calendar invites. Otherwise happy to coordinate dates that suit your team.

Best,
Marissa
